notes: Park at strong: coverage 97.6% (32 of 1337 TV trades unmatched) after the ta.sma exact-order window-sum fix. The residual is 100% TV-side and irreducible. Decomposition, measured against an independent Pine-faithful reference for the whole chain (ta.rsi via seeded RMA -> ta.stoch(rsi,rsi,rsi,14) -> k=ta.sma(stoch,3) -> d=ta.sma(k,3)) with exact-order window summation, comparing k and d BITWISE (raw IEEE-754 ULP delta) at the signal bar of every divergent entry: BEFORE the fix (engine 1292 matched, 96.6%) the engine contributed 38 TV-only entries at non-tie bars (running-sum drift SHIFTED real crosses) and 38 engine-only entries at exact-tie bars (drift MANUFACTURED crosses at algebraic ties); AFTER the fix (1305 matched, 97.6%) all 44 remaining TV-only entries sit on bars where k == d to the last bit (0 ULP), and all 44 paired engine-only entries sit on the next bar where the tie genuinely breaks. ta.crossover / ta.crossunder are STRICT inequalities, so no correct implementation at any precision may fire at an exact tie; the engine declines and TV fires. The construct saturates constantly - ta.stoch returns exactly 100.0 or 0.0 whenever rsi is its own 14-window extremum (x/x -> 1.0, *100 exact in IEEE-754) - and the three k-windows feeding d are then rotations of one multiset, so 9*(k-d) = 2*s_t + s_{t-1} - 2*s_{t-3} - s_{t-4} = 0 exactly. TV's own behaviour at those bars is inconsistent: inside the comparison window there are 508 bars with k == d bitwise, 506 of them inside the OB/OS gate (k<20 or k>80) where a cross would book a trade, and TV fires on exactly 44 of the 506 - 8.7%, roughly one tie in eleven. This is the finding-384 class (TV's SMA is not a function of its window; ties are broken TV-side rather than by the data). Reaching excellent is not available to any correct engine: COVERAGE_EXCELLENT is 0.99 and the small-N escape needs <=1 unmatched TV trade, so closing the gap would mean firing strict inequalities on equality - re-introducing exactly the running-sum drift the fix removes - and then also reproducing WHICH 8.7% of ties TV picks. Anomaly-candidate for the tv-anomaly register; the 506-tie / 44-fire measurement is the write-up material.
